_readme: Week 11 failure -> test loop. Every confirmed production failure is added here (with the trace_id it was found under) and tests/test_failures.py replays ALL of them on every run, so a fixed mistake cannot quietly come back. To add one: find it with week11_logs.py, copy its question/answer, add an entry, run pytest.

cases.found_via: code review of app.py during the Week 11 analysis (no trace id: found before request logging existed)
cases.complaint: Asking for a NON-vegetarian kimchi filtered the search to vegetarian recipes - the opposite diet.
cases.question: Can you give me a non-vegetarian kimchi recipe?

cases.complaint: 'non-vegan' matched the substring 'vegan' and applied the vegan filter.
cases.question: Show me a non-vegan kimchi

cases.complaint: The fix must not stop detecting a genuine 'vegan' request.
cases.question: Is there a vegan kimchi?

cases.complaint: Customer was told the brioche has a dairy-free swap; the answer recommended ghee, which is dairy.
cases.answer: Yes - a dairy-free swap for the butter in the brioche is ghee at a 1:1 ratio, which keeps the dough rich.

cases.found_via: guard against false positives for F004
cases.complaint: The guard must not flag the CORRECT swaps from the ingredient database.
cases.answer: A dairy-free swap for the butter is vegan block butter at 1:1, and oat milk replaces the whole milk, instead of ghee.

cases.found_via: root-cause check for F004: does the TOOL ever offer a non-dairy-free swap?
cases.complaint: get_substitutes(butter, 'dairy-free') must only return substitutes tagged dairy-free, and never ghee.
